methodology.coverage: All 4077 retained candidates were rescreened. HAL DOI lookup covered every one of their 4007 distinct publication targets. Existing papers were rescanned through their acknowledgments, excluding reference lists. Direct primary repository pages and current deposits supplemented indexed primary records.
methodology.manualReview: Selected source headings, author teams, publication notices, full-paper identity exceptions and bibliographic matches were reviewed before approval. An identical downloaded file is not independent body evidence. Imported DOI values never establish source identity.
methodology.retention: Uncertain targets, supporting documents, conference summaries, journal mismatches and competing DOI records remain separate. Failed or unavailable sources are not confirmations.
methodology.limits: Search and Crossref metadata requests stopped on rate limits. HAL paper download stopped on its first access denial; no new full texts were obtained in this pass. HAL metadata and direct repository checks continued independently. No source requiring personal contact information was used.
